title: Country-related cooperation programme with Colombia (COLFUTURO - Fundación para el Futuro de Colombia) Master
summary: Grants for very well qualified Colombian graduates to complete a Master's degree in Germany, co-funded by COLFUTURO and DAAD.

degree_levels.notes: Master's degree programme; applicants must have accomplished a first university degree (bachelor or equivalent).

residence.notes: Country in which you are living and from which you are applying is Colombia.

mandatory.text: Accomplished a first university degree (bachelor or equivalent) at the time of application

funding.description: Intensive German course in Germany (up to 6 months incl. accommodation and cost of living); costs of outward and return travel; monthly scholarship payments up to the maximum amount determined by COLFUTURO; medical, nursing care, accident and personal liability insurance; cost of German language course for accompanying spouse; refund of TestDaF or DSH exam; one-year research and study allowance. COLFUTURO contribution is a scholarship credit which is paid back in full or in part.
funding.duration: Approx. 2 years depending on the duration of the Master's programme

application_rounds.notes: No confirmed dates on this page.
